source.snippet: We let AI agents loose on a payment platform. They crushed the boring stuff. Then they silently broke... [25 score, 47 comments — active discussion about AI agent failure modes in production codebases]

problem_statement: AI coding agents silently introduce subtle bugs in high-stakes code paths (payments, auth, data integrity) that automated tests miss, and teams have no targeted review or guardrail layer for AI-generated changes in these critical zones.
target_segment: Senior engineers and tech leads at startups and scaleups running AI-assisted development on production services handling payments or sensitive data
notes: 47 comments signals real resonance. The '80/20 problem' of AI coding is a repeating theme. Opportunity: a static-analysis or LLM-review layer specifically for AI-generated diffs touching flagged high-risk modules.
